Container.Name: harvest
Container.Overview: Self-hosted seedbox to homelab sync. Pulls files from FTP/FTPS/SFTP servers to local folders on a schedule with a ledger so deleted files are never re-downloaded. Phase 1 core: settle check, staging+atomic rename, filters, cron/interval/manual scheduling, live dashboard, builtin auth. Phase 2: webhooks with job-scoped API tokens (qBittorrent/rTorrent/Deluge snippets included), post-sync actions (delete after N days, move), dry-run mode, time-of-day bandwidth profiles, archive extraction (zip/7z/RAR), Sonarr/Radarr scan triggers with path mapping, notifications (ntfy/Discord/Telegram/Pushover/webhook). SFTP host-key pinning, resume/checkpoints, parallel byte ranges, per-job settings, atomic ledger.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the Harvest web interface.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage: SQLite database (db/), temporary files (tmp/), and logs.

Config.Name: Target Directory
Config.Description: Example download target. Map any number of additional paths under /data/<name> (e.g., -e /data/tv:/mnt/user/tv). Staging (.harvest-staging) is created inside each target, so staging and destination must be on the same mount. Never map a target such that staging and final path cross filesystems.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Encrypts stored remote credentials. Keep it stable: changing it makes saved credentials unreadable. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. If unset, a key is auto-generated and stored in /config/.app_secret (back it up separately).

Config.Name: Auth Mode
Config.Description: Authentication mode: builtin (single user, session cookie) or none (no login, use only behind your own reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Admin User
Config.Description: Username for the first admin user (builtin auth only). Applied only when no user exists.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the first admin user. Minimum 8 characters. Applied only when no user exists.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The public URL of the app (e.g., https://harvest.example.com). Used to generate webhook URLs and validate cross-site requests. Recommended if AUTH_MODE=none.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for schedules and log timestamps (e.g., Europe/London).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask (e.g., 002 allows group writes).

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: silent, fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Configure trust in reverse-proxy headers (X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Proto). Options: false (default), true (trust any proxy—only safe if it overwrites X-Forwarded-For), a hop count like 1, or a comma-separated list of proxy IPs/CIDRs.

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Optional Host header allowlist (comma-separated). If set, requests with an unknown Host are rejected with 421. Useful to block DNS rebinding attacks.

Config.Name: Cookie Secure
Config.Description: Set to true when the app is served over HTTPS (via a reverse proxy). Controls the Secure flag on session cookies.

Config.Name: Max Concurrent Runs
Config.Description: Maximum number of jobs that can run concurrently.

Config.Name: Max Concurrent Files
Config.Description: Maximum number of files being transferred across all concurrent runs.

Config.Name: Stall Timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: Kill and retry a byte range if no bytes arrive in this many seconds.

Config.Name: Connect Timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: Timeout for rclone to connect and deliver the first byte.

Config.Name: Range Min Bytes
Config.Description: Files smaller than this (256 MB default) use a single byte range. Larger files split into multiple parallel ranges.

Config.Name: Checkpoint Bytes
Config.Description: Fsync and checkpoint progress every N bytes per range (16 MB default). A crash loses at most this much progress.

Config.Name: Browse Roots
Config.Description: Comma-separated container paths exposed in the local folder browser (e.g., /data,/media).

Config.Name: rclone Binary Path
Config.Description: Path to the rclone binary. The Docker image includes it at /usr/local/bin/rclone.
